**Track:** learn

## Buyer Story

Watch the delegation and token chain unfold step by step — see how each hop is minted and validated.

## PingOne Solution

An interactive visualization of the RFC 8693 token-exchange and Authorize flow — user token → delegated agent token → gateway → decision → tool.
